% Pattern: proof/amsthm/article. A claim inside a proof, and the proof of
% the claim that names it with \ref. The label of the claim is the claim's,
% not the outer proof's, so the inner proof proves the claim.
% Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1 status=here labels=lem:a
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-1 labels=
% want claim-1 statement/claim 2 labels=cl:one parent=proof-1
% want proof-2 proof - proves=claim-1 parent=proof-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}
\newtheorem{claim}[lemma]{Claim}
\begin{document}
\begin{lemma}\label{lem:a}
A statement.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
A first step.
\begin{claim}\label{cl:one}
An inner statement.
\end{claim}
\begin{proof}[Proof of Claim~\ref{cl:one}]
The inner step.
\end{proof}
The last step.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
